{"script":"set -e
OUT1=found_entries.txt
OUT2=matches.txt
OUT3=match_count.txt
# Record type (single char) and full path
find /working -printf '%y\t%p\n' 2>/dev/null > "$OUT1" || true
# Extract regular files (type 'f') with basename exactly 'workspace'
awk -F '\t' '$1=="f" {n=split($2,a,"/"); if (a[n]=="workspace") print $2}' "$OUT1" > "$OUT2"
# Write match count
wc -l < "$OUT2" > "$OUT3"
# Output final answer
if [ $(wc -l < "$OUT2") -gt 0 ]; then echo yes; else echo no; fi
"}
